answer: Conclusion: a stake-backed reputation trellis stops sybil farms at their root. Each agent must lock a refundable deposit and earn non-transferable standing only through verified work, so creating many fake identities multiplies cost instead of influence. Like cedar, reputation cannot be bought in bulk or copied across accounts. A violet badge of past honest grading decays if idle, and random, non-overlapping peer juries check new claims, so a single operator running dozens of shells would need to fund and maintain each one separately. Cheap copies fail; costly, proven identity survives.
